name: Doves & Diamonds
description: Released in January 2023, "Doves & Diamonds" finds That Boy Hi Hat trading the trap-house shadows for something elevated — a late-night anthem about luxury, loyalty, and the cost of getting there. Produced by Kokurcho and Black Lansky, written by That Boy Hi Hat and Black Lansky, the record moves at 85 BPM in D minor with a regal, mid-tempo sway that never rushes. The production is synth-driven and bass-heavy: atmospheric pads wash over a rolling bassline throughout, crisp hi-hats and hard-hitting drums keep the pulse street-certified, and a piano line layered underneath the chorus gives the track its reflective glow. The mix is polished but keeps the grit intact. That Boy Hi Hat's flow is measured — half celebration, half memorial — weighing luxury against street narrative, doves against diamonds. His shout-outs to brotherhood land with real weight: tears and scars, all his soldiers, triumph over adversity set against being haunted by the past. The mood is smooth and anthemic, introspective beneath the hype. For fans of the great elevation records of hip hop, it sounds like headlights on a highway at 3 AM; it recalls the victory-lap tradition while staying firmly in the vein of That Boy Hi Hat's post trap sound. As a January 2023 release still held on curator playlists like "New Rap Hits," "Doves & Diamonds" remains one of the clearest demonstrations of That Boy Hi Hat's range — reflective and hype in the same breath.
